project: LingRuntime (LingBot World v2 1.3B, Strix Halo / gfx1151)
sourceOfTruthNote: This file is the machine-readable DAG state. docs/lingruntime/RESEARCH_AND_EXPERIMENT_DAG.md explains it for humans. Neither file duplicates full evidence contents; both reference existing artifacts by path.

resourcesAllowed.source-cpu: reading/writing source, docs, or DAG state; no GPU involved
resourcesAllowed.api-research: DSH/LLM-backed research campaign; no local GPU involved
resourcesAllowed.gpu-light: brief, non-sustained GPU use (e.g. device/env verification) that does not require exclusive ownership of the Radeon 8060S
resourcesAllowed.gpu-exclusive: sustained and/or timing-sensitive GPU work; only one gpu-exclusive node may run at a time on the Radeon 8060S
resourcesAllowed.implementation: code/config authoring, safely parallelizable in isolated worktrees; its GPU evaluation step (if any) is gpu-exclusive and must be called out explicitly in that node's notes

updateRule: Append to changelog on every accepted result; never rewrite or delete a prior node result/status to make history look cleaner. Corrections are new changelog entries, not edits to old ones.

nodes.name: Warmed RC1 Phase 0 waterfall
nodes.question: Where does a warmed, rolled RC1 12+6 action's latency actually go, and does it reproduce the 2026-09-11 historical RC1 measurement?
exitCriteria: >=3 independent unprofiled A/A rollouts captured
one representative rolled waterfall action captured with per-forward GPU-synchronized boundaries
classified against the 2026-09-11 historical RC1 measurement
nextIf: measured hotspots become candidate input to C5 only after C3/C4 confirm they remain relevant under the quality-approved configuration (see Parked Findings)
nodes.result: PASS/reproduced. Base-RGB median 939.9 ms (927.6-954.5 ms range, n=12 pooled rolled actions). Next-ready median 1258.9 ms (1244.8-1272.3 ms range). Reproduces the 2026-09-11 historical RC1 P50 (938.4 ms / 1255.3 ms) within measured A/A noise (delta +1.5 ms / +3.6 ms). Three serialized denoise forwards (~910 ms, ~97% of base-RGB) dominate base-RGB latency. The exact clean-KV forward (~298-300 ms) dominates most of the additional delay from base-RGB to next-ready (~93% of that ~320 ms delta). No optimization implemented.
nodes.notes: An independently-derived cross-check of this same raw evidence was reportedly written in the primary LingBot working tree on 2026-09-12 but is not committed on any branch as of this DAG; do not treat it as a citable artifact until it is committed and its path is confirmed. See 'Ambiguities' in the DAG markdown.

nodes.result: Reset discriminator executed (2026-09-12, validator base bad1234): classification BASELINE_NONDETERMINISM_OR_STRICT_HASH. Fresh A/B bootstraps differ with no rollout between, so the rollout was skipped and no leak is claimed. Noise/plucker/text-context stable bitwise; condition chunk 0 differs (max-abs 0.159), driving x0 (0.167), clean K (0.156), clean V (1.478) beyond tolerance. A matches the first-execution chunk 0 bitwise (first prepare reproduces across processes); third prepare matches B (X,Y,Y). VAE feature-cache staleness eliminated by inspection; first-encode warmup effect is the follow-up hypothesis, not a conclusion. Warmed-reset first execution (2026-09-12, uncommitted tree on 123db37, see dd0e4da dirt record): gate A==B strict PASS 7/7; rollout 15/16 with fresh_reset FAIL caused solely by the validator dict bug (reset_pos carries cache_capacity_tokens; all semantic sub-checks true in data); C==A FAIL with C.condition==warmup X. Dict bug fixed in ec3b4f1; C1/C2 recovery probe added; rerun pending. Rerun on fixed code (2026-09-12, base 06ba33c clean): gate 7/7 PASS; rollout PASS all 16 assertions including fresh_reset; C==A FAIL (C.condition==warmup X once); recovery RECOVERED_IMMEDIATELY (C1==C2==A bitwise). The post-rollout first-encode reversion lasts exactly one prepare and self-heals. WARMED_RESET_PASS not achieved, so C1R closure needs an explicit reset-criterion decision; C2 stays blocked. CLOSURE (2026-09-12, autonomous evaluation): qualified PASS. Exit-criteria audit against the rerun rollout verdict (PASS, all 16 true, base 06ba33c): exact operating point (12/6, 999/899/702, chunk 1, 384x672, BF16 DiT, FP16 TAEHV, deferred clean-t0); fill/first-eviction/repeated rolls match the independent reference; clean-t0 overwrites without advancing; fixture labels forward/turn/reversal/revisit; fresh_reset PASSES post-fix with stale and broken-KV controls still detected (controls discriminate). The WARMED_C_MISMATCH wrapper reflects the single-prepare post-rollout X-reversion, fully characterized with RECOVERED_IMMEDIATELY proof; blanket bitwise C==A is superseded as a reset criterion by gate 7/7 + in-rollout fresh_reset strict PASS. Original conclusion stands: first-encode behavior, not leakage.
nodes.notes: Closed by qualified PASS. Downstream C2 entry criteria evaluated as satisfied; see C2.notes. No optimization, no production change.

nodes.question: Under a matched-state comparison, what in the current pipeline actually determines output quality, and does the RC1 latency-oriented configuration (3-step denoise, TAEHV presentation, 12+6 window) hold acceptable quality, or does some axis need to change before we freeze a contract in C3?
entryCriteria: C1R reset closure: first-encode probe confirms the prepare effect and the strict post-warmup reset criterion passes (a blanket bitwise C1R PASS on the original unwarmed path is superseded)

nodes.result: PASS (2026-09-12). Bounded chunk/context screen complete: A1/A2 bitwise identical across processes (zero noise floor); window 18 vs 12 identical until chunk 12 then diverges (smaller-window first eviction; RGB MAD to 0.030, no viewed degradation); denoise 4-step materially different everywhere and visibly softer than 3-step (RC1 choice quality-supported); decoder MAD 0.0237, TAEHV stands. Context-sensitive branch triggered-bounded then resolved on saved frames; all other follow-ups explicitly not triggered with reasons. All runs finite, temporal stats stable, no drift.
nodes.notes: Closed by screen verdict. C3 consumes this as the quality basis for the contract freeze.
